title: Product Task & Phase Task Register — Three-tier Product Delivery Register
authority: Derived governing structure agreed by Vinh; Xu may implement within delegated Work 70 scope. No final product acceptance/release authority is implied.

model.tier_1: Product Task — one summary task per product
model.tier_2: Phase Task — one task per product per lifecycle phase, with primary_agent, contributing_agents and checking_agent
model.tier_3: Agent Task — DOC-093 remains canonical work-level role task register; product-phase links are explicitly shared support references until product-specific Agent Tasks are assigned.

rules: Product Task is the top-level summary; it does not replace phase or agent registers.
Each Product Task has exactly one Phase Task per lifecycle phase.
Every Phase Task must name one primary agent, zero or more contributing agents, and one checking agent; assignments remain PROPOSED until capability, permission and ACK are verified.
Checking agent must be independent of the primary agent for the deliverable under review; no self-approval.
DOC-093 remains the only source of existing Agent Tasks. DOC-094 may reference DOC-093 IDs but must not copy or redefine their status.
Shared DOC-093 Agent Task links are work-level support links, not proof of product-specific assignment, execution or ACK.
Agent Task DONE does not make Phase Task DONE. Phase Task DONE requires deliverable, acceptance criteria and evidence.
Product Task DONE requires all required Phase Tasks and product acceptance evidence; no automatic gate promotion.
Progress is null/NOT_CALCULATED until approved weights and evidence-backed completion rules exist; never average agent percentages as product progress.
Execution events and test results append to DOC-035; meetings and decisions reference DOC-034 and DOC-006.
Dashboard projections are read-only and generated from DOC-093 and DOC-094; never edit projection as source.
Unknown, stale, unverified and blocked states must remain explicit; no fabricated PASS.

progress_policy.reason: No approved phase weights or product-level aggregation formula yet.
prohibited_methods: treating source file presence as acceptance
treating static checks as browser/runtime/QE PASS
